name: io.github.VictoriaMetrics-Community/mcp-victoriatraces
description: MCP Server for VictoriaTraces. Provides integration with VictoriaTraces API and documentation

environmentVariables.name: VT_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT
environmentVariables.description: URL to VictoriaTraces instance (it should be root URL of vtsingle or vtselect), for example http://localhost:10428. Required unless VMC_API_KEY is set, cannot be used with VMC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: VT_INSTANCE_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: authentication token for VictoriaTraces API

environmentVariables.name: VMC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: API key from VictoriaMetrics Cloud Console (if you have VictoriaTraces deployments in VictoriaMetrics Cloud). Required unless VT_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT is set, cannot be used with VT_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT

environmentVariables.name: VMC_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: base URL of the VictoriaMetrics Cloud API, https://api.victoriametrics.cloud by default

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
